idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; the master (actor 0, thread 0) relays every created task to worker (srC + scC) % workers on thread floor(w x cores / workers) -- qb's placement; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. A task is one ring message carrying the Task's fields, a done one ring message, and every leaf is the same shared kernel every framework runs: the floor for a recursive decomposition relayed through one master

worker w is owned by thread floor(w x cores / workers) and the master by thread 0, fixed before the window -- qb's placement exactly: with cores=2 thread 0 multiplies 304 of the default's 512 leaves and thread 1 208, never rebalanced, so this floor bounds the placing frameworks and NOT the pools
cores=1 is one thread with every actor's messages in its own ring -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
